lines.en: label dormwarssix1:
scene noonsky
I’ve found myself in a familiar place today.
lines.zh: 今天我又一次身处熟悉的地方。

lines.en: {size=-2}But I suppose that’s nothing new when my life’s become nothing but a series of blasé routines that, more often than not, end with me praying to the God of Infertility to work Their magic on whoever it was I just came inside of.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}不过我想这也没什么新鲜的，毕竟我的人生已经只剩下一连串索然无味的例行公事，而这些例行公事十有八九都以我向不育之神祈祷、求他对刚刚被我射进体内的那个人显灵作结。{/size}

lines.en: {size=-2}But in making this joke I realize that I might actually be contracted to such an entity through means I am presently unaware of, so my morning monologue is now more mysterious and less whimsical than I’d have liked.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}可说着这个笑话，我意识到自己说不定真的通过某种我目前尚不知情的途径跟这么一位存在签了约，于是我的晨间独白就变得比我想要的更神秘、也更不轻快了。{/size}

lines.en: That’s probably for the best, though. Our “team” is growing after all. And pretty soon, we might be able to get enough people on the rooftop to cause some sort of collapse that somehow saves us all.
lines.zh: 不过这样大概也好。毕竟我们的「队伍」在壮大。而且很快，我们也许就能凑够人站上天台，引发某种坍塌，然后在阴差阳错间拯救所有人。

lines.en: It’s a shot in the dark, sure. But what isn’t these days?
lines.zh: 当然，这是瞎猜。但这年头又有什么不是呢？

lines.en: It does make me wonder about the {i}endgame{/i} here, though.
lines.zh: 不过这确实让我好奇起这里的{i}终局{/i}。

lines.en: If we {i}do{/i} get to a point where everyone’s just...{i}aware{/i} of where we are (or {i}when{/i} we are), could there be some sort of harmony?
lines.zh: 如果我们{i}真的{/i}走到了那一步——每个人都只是{i}意识到{/i}我们在哪里（或者{i}何时{/i}），会不会存在某种和谐？

lines.en: A way for us to live and...
lines.zh: 一种让我们活下去、然后……

lines.en: Well, that’s it.
lines.zh: 好吧，就是这样。

lines.en: Just {i}live.{/i}
lines.zh: 只是{i}活着{/i}。

lines.en: It sounds like Hell to me, honestly.
lines.zh: 说实话，这听起来跟地狱没什么两样。

lines.en: Especially now that I’m more determined than ever to put an {i}actual{/i} end to all of this rather than some hypothetical one that would ultimately result in me having a seemingly infinite amount of sex.
lines.zh: 尤其是现在，我比以往任何时候都更决心要给这一切画上一个{i}真正的{/i}句号，而不是某种假想的句号——那种只会让我最终拥有看似无限量的性爱的句号。

lines.en: Turns out even those who love their job get tired of working after so long. Which means my endless pursuit of a thing called happiness can rear its ugly face again and crawl through the windows into my room.
lines.zh: 事实证明，就算是热爱自己工作的人，干久了也会累。这意味着我对那个叫幸福的东西的无尽追逐，可以再次抬起它丑陋的脸，从窗户爬进我的房间。

lines.en: Let it smother me while everyone outside does all the work. Because I’m beginning to think that is the only way I’ll ever feel it at all.
lines.zh: 就让它把我闷死吧，反正外面的活儿全由别人干。因为我开始觉得，这是我能感受到它的唯一方式。

lines.en: But even then, as its metaphorical hips gyrate to extract more subconscious pleasure out of my symbolic phallus, I’m not sure I’ll be able to accept or understand it.
lines.zh: 可即便如此，当它隐喻的腰肢扭动、从我这象征性的阳具里榨取更多潜意识快感时，我也不确定自己能否接受或理解它。

lines.en: Because being here, face to face with one man’s Heaven, has done little to prove to me that I should stop thinking of death so much.
lines.zh: 因为站在这里，与一个人的天堂面对面，也没怎么向我证明我该少想点死亡。

lines.en: And if not even this makeshift afterlife can save me, it must mean that my “peace” requires something more fluid.
lines.zh: 如果连这个凑合出来的来世都救不了我，那我的「平静」一定需要点更流动的东西。

lines.en: Something that keeps moving instead of just sitting in the corner of the room and growing under the light of the sun and the occasional squeeze of a bottle to help keep it wet.
lines.zh: 某种一直在动的东西，而不是只会待在房间角落里、在阳光下生长、偶尔还得靠挤一下瓶子来保持湿润的东西。

lines.en: All it does is make me think of the end even more. Accept that not accepting it does little to help my fear of it one day claiming me.
lines.zh: 这一切只是让我更加想到终结。接受这一点：不接受它，对我害怕它有一天把我带走这件事毫无帮助。

lines.en: : LET’S FUCKING GOOOOOOOOOOO! DORM WAAAAAARS!
lines.zh: : 他妈的冲啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！宿舍战啊啊啊啊争！

lines.en: I suppose that fear hasn’t come for Uta yet, though.
lines.zh: 不过，这份恐惧似乎还没找上 Uta。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix1
: IT’S MY MOST RELEVANT TIME OF THE YEAR AGAIN!
lines.zh: : 一年里我最有存在感的时刻又到啦！

lines.en: : Yo, if you’re gonna shout out curse words like that, at least keep the volume low enough that everybody in the class next door doesn’t hear it too.
lines.zh: : 喂，你要这么喊脏话，至少把音量压低点，别让隔壁班的人全听见。

lines.en: : I’LL CONSIDER IT!
lines.zh: : 我会考虑的！

lines.en: As you can see, learning that we’re caught in an infinite loop of her high school years has done little to affect her mood. In fact, I might even wager that she’s in a {i}better{/i} mood lately.
lines.zh: 如你所见，得知我们被困在她高中岁月的无限循环里，对她的心情几乎没造成什么影响。事实上，我甚至敢打赌她最近心情{i}更好{/i}了。

lines.en: But that might just be on account of now being able to overlook the timeline she thought she had to win my affection despite already having done that.
lines.zh: 但这也许只是因为，她现在能不去管那条她曾经以为必须用来赢得我的心的世界线——尽管她早就赢得过了。

lines.en: : Hey. Shut up.
lines.zh: : 喂。闭嘴。

lines.en: Makoto’s the same too, as you can see.
lines.zh: Makoto 也一样，如你所见。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix2
: Sorry, Makocchi. I’ll be good. I promise. You can go ahead and read off all of our contests now.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啦，Makocchi。我会乖的。我保证。你现在可以把我们所有比赛项目念一遍了。

lines.en: : Wait, no! Senpai doesn’t stop in very often anymore and I have to formally introduce him to make him feel welcome before we do anything else!
lines.zh: : 等等，不行！Senpai 现在已经不常来了，在做别的事之前我得先正式介绍他一下，让他有宾至如归的感觉！

lines.en: : I’ve been here for an hour, Imani. I’ve already talked to everyone.
lines.zh: : 我都来了一个小时了，Imani。我已经跟所有人聊过了。

lines.en: : Okay, but I was on lunch and missed out on all of that. At least let me shout really excitedly?
lines.zh: : 好吧，可我刚才在午休，全都错过了。至少让我激动地喊两句吧？

lines.en: : Fine. Go.
lines.zh: : 行。喊吧。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix3
: MY BOY IS BAAAAAACK IN CLASS! YEAAAAAAAAHHH!
lines.zh: : 我的男人回班上来啦啊啊啊啊！耶eeeeeeeeee！

lines.en: scene dormwarssix4
: For {i}today.{/i}
lines.zh: : 只限{i}今天{/i}。

lines.en: : NOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!
lines.zh: : 不oooooooooooo！！！！

lines.en: : And also tomorrow if we wind up coming back here since knocking out the Dorm Wars in one day would piss off everyone looking forward to the inevitable sleepover.
lines.zh: : 明天也在——如果我们还会回到这儿的话，毕竟一天之内把宿舍战争打完会惹毛所有盼着那场注定要办的睡衣派对的人。

lines.en: : You mean Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你是说 Ayane？

lines.en: : Yes, I mean Ayane.
lines.zh: : 对，我是说 Ayane。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix5
: I’m Ayane. What’s going on? I zoned out.
lines.zh: : 我是 Ayane。怎么了？我走神了。

lines.en: : Sleepovers.
lines.zh: : 睡衣派对。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix6
: Oh, I love those.
lines.zh: : 哦，我喜欢。

lines.en: : That’s exactly what they were saying.
lines.zh: : 她们刚才说的就是这个。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix7
: Since when do {i}you{/i} pay attention to anything that’s said in class?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}什么时候开始注意课上说的内容了？

lines.en: : Since the guy saying it became the same guy I’ve had copious amounts of rough sex with. Now, watch as I maintain eye contact to guilt him into wanting me and only me again.
lines.zh: : 自从说这话的那个人，变成了跟我做过成吨粗暴性爱的那个人。看着吧，我要一直跟他保持眼神接触，用愧疚感逼他重新只想要我一个。

lines.en: : Good luck. I think that’s why Noriko’s eyes always look the way they do and that hasn’t worked for her yet.
lines.zh: : 祝你好运。我觉得 Noriko 的眼睛之所以一直是那副样子就是因为这招，可她到现在也没成功过。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix8
: Good point. Maybe I just need to open mine wider.
lines.zh: : 有道理。也许我只需要把眼睛睁得更大点。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’ll do it for sure.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那肯定管用。

lines.en: : Sensei! And also Imani-sensei! I propose that we just start the Dorm Wars tomorrow and that we get a head start on the sleepover right now!
lines.zh: : Sensei！还有 Imani-sensei！我提议咱们明天再开始宿舍战争，现在就提前把睡衣派对办起来！

lines.en: : {i}Dump your stupid fake girlfriend and love me, you pathetic idol-fucking predator. {/i}
lines.zh: {i}甩了你那个蠢兮兮的假女朋友，来爱我吧，你这个睡偶像的可怜捕食者。 {/i}

lines.en: scene dormwarssix9
: Maya, stop doing that thing with your eyes. You’re starting to look like Chika ever since we announced that Niki would be making an appearance this year.
lines.zh: : Maya，别再用眼睛做那个动作了。自从我们宣布 Niki 今年会出场，你就越来越像 Chika 了。

lines.en: Why do I feel so drawn to her all of a sudden?
lines.zh: 为什么我突然这么被她吸引？

lines.en: : Also, we {i}need{/i} to do this now or it’ll make me look bad. I managed to score us a half-day while every {i}other{/i} class has to stick around until the last bell rings.
lines.zh: : 还有，我们{i}必须{/i}现在就开始，不然我会很没面子。别的{i}所有{/i}班都得待到最后一声铃响，而我帮大家争取到了半天假。

lines.en: : Does that also explain what the TV crew is doing here again? Or were you guys also planning on starting some sort of school-based reality show?
lines.zh: : 那也能解释电视台的摄制组怎么又来了？还是说你们还打算搞一档校园真人秀？

lines.en: scene dormwarssix10
: Our interviews and the first couple contests are being broadcast to the rest of the school. They don’t stop rolling until we go over to Chika’s place later.
lines.zh: : 我们的采访和最初几个比赛项目会向全校转播。他们要一直拍到我们稍后去 Chika 家才会停机。

lines.en: : Yeah, y’all should probably just, like...{i}not{/i} do that. Chika clearly ain’t fit to host right now.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你们大概应该……就{i}别{/i}这么干了。Chika 现在明显不适合主持。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix11
: Well, Chika’s going to have to figure that out as soon as possible because she’s competing today as well.
lines.zh: : 那 Chika 也得尽快想明白，因为她今天也要参赛。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix12
: And given that this year’s competition once again involves Sensei as a prize and not just bragging rights, there are nine other girls counting on her to win.
lines.zh: : 考虑到今年的比赛又一次把 Sensei 当成奖品，而不只是吹牛的资本，还有九个女生指望她能赢。

lines.en: : Don’t lump me in with them if you know what’s good for you, Prez.
lines.zh: : 你要是识相就别把我跟她们混为一谈，会长。

lines.en: : Stop being such a tsundere and admit you love him already, Yumi. We all know it.
lines.zh: : 别傲娇了，承认你爱他吧，Yumi。我们都知道。

lines.en: : Wha- no?! No, I don’t! The fuck are you talkin’ about?!
lines.zh: : 什——才不是？！我才没有！你他妈在说什么啊？！

lines.en: : Yeah, what gives?! Yumi loves {i}me!{/i} Onii-chan’s just my greatest rival.
lines.zh: : 就是啊，搞什么？！Yumi 爱的是{i}我{/i}！哥哥只是我最强的劲敌。

lines.en: : That ain’t true either! You guys are fuckin’-
lines.zh: : 那也不是真的！你们他妈的——

lines.en: : Blah, blah, blah. Drama, drama, drama. Everyone in this room including Miss Imai wants to win Sensei and so we should just bypass all of this small talk and get down to brass tacks. We-
lines.zh: : 废话，废话，废话。戏真多，戏真多。这屋里包括 Imai 老师在内每个人都想赢走 Sensei，所以我们干脆跳过这些寒暄，直奔正题。我们——

lines.en: : Now, hol’ up. Does that mean I can also win him if there’s a tie or something?
lines.zh: : 等等，等等。那是不是说要是打平了什么的，我也能赢走他？

lines.en: scene dormwarssix13
: I...guess that seems fair to me. Uta?
lines.zh: : 我……嘛，我觉得挺公平的。Uta？

lines.en: : No. I win him if there’s a tie.
lines.zh: : 不行。打平的话我赢。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix14
: That seems less fair to me. Why?
lines.zh: : 那我觉得就不太公平了。为什么？

lines.en: : Because I deserve him, obviously.
lines.zh: : 因为我配得上他，这还用说。

lines.en: : In what scenario does Miss Imai win him then?
lines.zh: : 那什么情况下 Imai 老师能赢走他？

lines.en: : There isn’t one. I win no matter what because I am the queen of Dorm Wars. It’s the new rule.
lines.zh: : 没有那种情况。无论怎样都是我赢，因为我是宿舍战争的女王。这是新规则。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m going to have to reject this proposal. In the event of a tie, Miss Imai is now going to be the winner.
lines.zh: : 行，这个提案我得驳回。如果打平，赢家现在改成 Imai 老师。

lines.en: : WOOO! OBJECTIFICATION! I MIGHT WIN A MAN!
lines.zh: : 哇哦哦！物化！我可能会赢到一个男人！

lines.en: scene dormwarssix15
: You’ll pay for this when the apocalypse comes, Makocchi...
lines.zh: : 等世界末日来了，你要为这件事付出代价的，Makocchi……

lines.en: : If {i}this{/i} is somehow the thing that manages to smite me after all this time, so be it.
lines.zh: : 如果{i}这{/i}就是熬了这么久终于能把我击垮的东西，那就来吧。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix16
: In the meantime, though, let’s recap. All contests this year were chosen via audience poll, so please don’t be mad at us if you don’t like what you received.
lines.zh: : 不过在那之前，我们先回顾一下。今年所有比赛项目都是观众投票选出来的，所以如果你不喜欢抽到的项目，也请别怪我们。

lines.en: : Competition one — Athletics Abound. A fitness test pitting...{i}me...{/i}up against Nodoka. {i}Again.{/i} I have never been less excited for anything in my life.
lines.zh: : 第一项——运动大爆发。一场体能测试，让……{i}我{/i}……对上 Nodoka。{i}又来。{/i}我这辈子从没对哪件事这么提不起劲过。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix17
: Ah. So the audience went with the sabotage route instead of choosing people who might be good at stuff. Got it.
lines.zh: : 啊。所以观众选的是「坑人」路线，而不是挑可能擅长这些的人。明白了。

lines.en: : Competition two — Chaotic Cooking Class. Self explanatory. We’ll have Chika compete against Noriko for that one.
lines.zh: : 第二项——混乱烹饪课。顾名思义。这项我们让 Chika 对上 Noriko。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix18
: Wait, but they’re both good at that. Are we not doing the whole {i}sabotage{/i} thing after all? Let me read the next.
lines.zh: : 等等，可她俩都擅长这个啊。那我们到底还搞不搞那套{i}坑人{/i}了？我接着往下念。

lines.en: : Competition three — Familial Face Off. You can’t {i}choose{/i} your family, but...imagine you {i}could?{/i} Ami vs. Otoha. Two only-children.
lines.zh: : 第三项——亲情对决。家人是{i}选{/i}不了的，可是……想象一下如果你{i}能选{/i}呢？Ami 对 Otoha。两个独生女。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix19
: Or...only {i}childs?{/i} Which is correct there?
lines.zh: : 还是说……独生{i}子{/i}？哪个才对？

lines.en: scene dormwarssix20
: Competition four — Drawing With Nao-chan. Because we are apparently roping actual children into the Dorm Wars now. Wonderful. Maya vs Yasu. Two people who are very good with children, I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 第四项——和 Nao 酱一起画画。因为现在我们显然连真正的小孩都要拉进宿舍战争了。真好。Maya 对 Yasu。两个都很会带小孩的人，我敢肯定。

lines.en: : After that, the final competition of the day will be a new flash dating version of the fan favorite Date War where each girl will only have {i}ten{/i} minutes to prove their worth.
lines.zh: : 之后，今天的最后一项比赛将是备受粉丝喜爱的「约会战争」的全新闪约版本，每个女生只有{i}十{/i}分钟来证明自己的价值。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix21
: In which {i}I{/i} finally get a chance to shine by showing off my flirting skills against {i}Rin,{/i} who can’t flirt to save her life!
lines.zh: : 到时候{i}我{/i}终于有机会大放异彩，用我的调情技巧对上{i}Rin{/i}——她可是个调情白痴！

lines.en: : H-Hey! I’ve technically had the most girlfriends out of anyone in this class!
lines.zh: : 喂——喂！严格来说，全班里交过女朋友最多的就是我！

lines.en: : I think I’m also technically winning then.
lines.zh: : 那我觉得严格来说我也算赢了吧。

lines.en: : Makoto, be my girlfriend for the next thirty seconds so Rin stops bragging.
lines.zh: : Makoto，接下来三十秒当我女朋友，好让 Rin 别再吹了。

lines.en: : Fine.
scene dormwarssix22
: Wait, no! You weren’t supposed to agree! I don’t want {i}you{/i} to be my first!
lines.zh: : 等等，不对！你不该答应的！我可不想让{i}你{/i}当我的第一个！

lines.en: : Fine. Then I’m breaking up with you.
lines.zh: : 行。那我跟你分手。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix23
: AND NOW I’VE BEEN DUMPED!!! THIS IS SUPPOSED TO BE MY TIME TO SHINE!
lines.zh: : 我现在被甩了！！！这本来该是我大放异彩的时刻啊！

lines.en: : After Rin ultimately fails considering this year’s Date War will {i}not{/i} involve Sensei at the behest of Miss Imai-
lines.zh: : 在 Rin 最终失败之后——考虑到今年的约会战争应 Imai 老师的要求{i}不会{/i}让 Sensei 参与——

lines.en: : Wait, what?!
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？！

lines.en: : Sucks to suck, girl. I ain’t about to let y’all date an adult on my watch.
lines.zh: : 活该，丫头。我可不会在我眼皮子底下让你们跟一个成年人约会。

lines.en: : BUT YOU LET ME DO IT LITERALLY LAST YEAR!
lines.zh: : 可你去年的的确确让我这么干了啊！

lines.en: : Yeah, cause I know you and Io ain’t got the balls to do anything. You really think I’m gonna let Uta be alone in a room with Senpai in her current state?
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为我知道你和 Io 没那个胆子干出什么事。你真觉得我会让 Uta 以她现在这状态跟 Senpai 单独待在一个房间里？

lines.en: : MY BODY IS EXPERIENCING CHAAAANGEEEEES!
lines.zh: : 我的身体正在发生变aaaaaa化！

lines.en: : So, as I was saying, after Rin ultimately fails considering this year’s Date War will {i}not{/i} involve Sensei and will, instead, involve a {i}mystery guest,{/i} we’ll head to the hotel and prepare for tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 那么，正如我刚才说的，在 Rin 最终失败之后——考虑到今年的约会战争{i}不会{/i}让 Sensei 参与，而是会请来一位{i}神秘嘉宾{/i}——我们就动身去酒店，为明天做准备。

lines.en: : But for now, I’ll pass things over to our field reporter, Molly MacCormack, who must stall for the next twenty seconds while the rest of us run downstairs for our pre-game interviews.
lines.zh: : 不过现在，我把场子交给我们的外景记者 Molly MacCormack，她得拖上二十秒，好让我们其他人冲下楼去做赛前采访。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix24
: Top o’ the mornin’ to ya! Molly MacCormack here! Reporting {i}live{/i} from just outside of Kumon-mi High! And {i}boy,{/i} do we have a show in store for you this year!
lines.zh: : 早上好呀！这里是 Molly MacCormack！正在 Kumon-mi 高中门外为您{i}现场{/i}报道！{i}天哪{/i}，今年我们给大家准备的节目可精彩了！

lines.en: scene dormwarssix25
: Joining me now are Futaba Fukuyama and Nodoka Nagasawa — two girls who were very insistent on being out here beforehand so they would not have to run with the rest of the class.
lines.zh: : 现在加入我的是 Futaba Fukuyama 和 Nodoka Nagasawa——两位坚持要提前守在这儿，这样就不用跟着全班一起跑的姑娘。

lines.en: : But something I’m sure all the viewers at home are wondering is how exactly you expect to {i}win{/i} your athletics competition with literally {i}no{/i} drive to exercise at all, Nodoka. What do you have to say to that?
lines.zh: : 不过我相信家里所有观众都在好奇一件事：你到底打算怎么在{i}完全{/i}没有运动动力的情况下{i}赢{/i}下田径比赛，Nodoka。对此你有什么要说的吗？

lines.en: : {size=-2}Apologies for the inconvenience, but I am only here to touch my friend. And I do not intend to win the athletics competition as I was put on this planet for one purpose and one purpose only — convincing Futaba that she is a lesbian.{/i}
lines.zh: {size=-2}抱歉给您添麻烦了，不过我来这儿只是为了摸我的朋友。我也不打算赢下田径比赛，因为我降临在这个星球上只有一个目的、且仅有一个——说服 Futaba 她是个同性恋。{/i}

lines.en: : And what do you have to say to that, Futaba? Is it working?
lines.zh: : Futaba，对此你有什么要说的吗？管用吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不管用。

lines.en: : Alas. It appears I must try even harder...
lines.zh: : 唉。看来我得更努力才行……

lines.en: scene dormwarssix26
: Ah! And would you look at this?! It seems that Touka’s joined us before we even had the chance to {i}mention{/i} her competition against Futaba here.
lines.zh: : 啊！快看这个？！我们还没来得及{i}提到{/i} Touka 和 Futaba 之间的比赛，她就已经加入到我们中间了。

lines.en: : It’s easy to forget just how athletic I am when I excel in virtually everything. I have a lot of practice moving downstairs given the size of my family’s home.
lines.zh: : 我几乎样样精通，所以很容易让人忘了我有多擅长运动。考虑到我家房子有多大，我在上下楼上可练得多了。

lines.en: : I guess I’ll be glad you and I aren’t competing in the first contest then, Touka.
lines.zh: : 那我还挺高兴我跟你不在第一项比赛里碰上，Touka。

lines.en: : Yes. And might I say, I’m quite excited to be competing against you this year, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 是啊。而且我得说，今年能跟你同场竞技我相当兴奋，Futaba。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix27
: Now, for those who don’t already know, Futaba and Touka-
lines.zh: : 那么，给还不知道的观众介绍一下，Futaba 和 Touka——

lines.en: scene dormwarssix28
: Hello. I am also here now.
lines.zh: : 你们好。我现在也到这儿了。

lines.en: : Ah! So quick! Could it be that Makoto’s competitive spirit has given her the drive needed to excel in a competition where the odds are stacked against her?!
lines.zh: : 啊！好快！难道说 Makoto 的好胜心给了她在一场胜算渺茫的比赛中脱颖而出所需的动力？！

lines.en: : I wouldn’t say they’re stacked against her at all. In fact, I’d go so far as to say she has an advantage given all of the...{i}cardio{/i} she’s done with our “prize” prior to this year.
lines.zh: : 我可一点都不觉得她胜算渺茫。事实上，我甚至会说她有优势——毕竟她今年之前跟我们的「奖品」做了那么多……{i}有氧运动{/i}。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix29
: Cardio?
lines.zh: : 有氧运动？

lines.en: : Why, yes. My rigorous {i}training{/i} routine with Sensei has most certainly prepared me to wipe the floor with you, Nodoka. I hope you’re looking forward to it.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，对呀。我跟 Sensei 那套严格的{i}训练{/i}日程，毫无疑问已经让我做好了把你按在地上摩擦的准备，Nodoka。希望你很期待。

lines.en: : Oh, I can assure you I am. In fact, there are few things I’d like more than having you drag me across a dirty floor to mop up the residue of your {i}exercise{/i} routine.
lines.zh: : 哦，我可以向你保证我很期待。事实上，我最想要的莫过于被你拖过脏地板，好擦干净你那套{i}运动{/i}留下的残渍。

lines.en: : Disgusting. Just call your maid.
lines.zh: : 恶心。叫你女仆来干不就行了。

lines.en: : Now, without getting sidetracked any further, we {i}do{/i} still need to hear from Futaba and Touka about their {i}teaching{/i} competition.
lines.zh: : 好了，别再跑题了，我们{i}确实{/i}还得听听 Futaba 和 Touka 说说她们那场{i}教学{/i}比赛。

lines.en: : Because, from what I can remember, you actually wanted to be a teacher once upon a time. Didn’t you, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 因为据我所记得的，你以前其实想当老师来着。是吧，Futaba？

lines.en: : Uhh...not really. You’re probably thinking of Makoto.
lines.zh: : 呃……也不算吧。你想的大概是 Makoto。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix30
: Oh...well...my apologies if that is the case. I clearly need to do a little more research on our contestants.
lines.zh: : 哦……好吧……如果是这样那我道歉。我显然得对我们的参赛选手多下点功课。

lines.en: : It’s fine. Just because I don’t want to be a teacher doesn’t mean I’m not going to give it my all tomorrow. I just hope I’m able to keep my composure the way Touka certainly will.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我不想当老师，不代表明天我不会全力以赴。我只希望自己能像 Touka 那样保持镇定。

lines.en: : Being judged by {i}our{/i} teachers adds to the pressure, for sure. But, honestly, I don’t think there’s much they know that I don’t. So my strategy will be just doing what I {i}wish{/i} people would do for me.
lines.zh: : 被{i}我们自己的{/i}老师评判，压力肯定是有的。但说实话，我觉得他们懂的东西我也没几样不懂。所以我的策略就是：做我{i}希望{/i}别人为我做的事。

lines.en: : Well, I won’t pretend to be as smart as you or anything like that, but I’m not going to just roll over either. May the best girl win, Touka.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我不会装得跟你一样聪明什么的，但我也不会直接躺平认输。祝最强的姑娘获胜，Touka。

lines.en: : I’d say the same to Nodoka but, honestly, I would rather just destroy her once we make it to the park.
lines.zh: : 这话我也想对 Nodoka 说，不过说实话，我更想等到了公园再把她彻底击溃。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix31
: Come to think of it, though, we should probably head there now. I’d like to get changed so I don’t have to run around in a skirt.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，我们现在大概该过去了。我想换身衣服，这样就不用穿着裙子到处跑。

lines.en: : Five more minutes. I’m still trying to convert my beloved sister here so that we may one day cross the boundaries that all adolescent girls are meant to in order to {i}find themselves.{/i}
lines.zh: : 再等五分钟。我还在努力感化我亲爱的姐姐，好让我们有一天能跨过所有青春期少女为了{i}找到自我{/i}都该跨过的那条界线。

lines.en: : Well, unfortunately for our viewers, you’re going to have to do that off-screen since there are still a ton of interviews we need to get to!
lines.zh: : 唉，可惜我们的观众得失望了，这件事你得在镜头外做，因为我们还有一大堆采访要赶！

lines.en: scene dormwarssix32
: Before we do that, though, I’d like to tell you a little more about today’s sponsor — Rocket Money!
lines.zh: : 不过在那之前，我想再给大家介绍一下今天的赞助商——Rocket Money！

lines.en: scene dormwarssix33
: Do you like money? Well, so does the moon!
lines.zh: : 你喜欢钱吗？月亮也喜欢！

lines.en: : So put all of your money in a giant rocket and send it there so they can build an Arby’s for when we’re all forced to evacuate the planet. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 所以把你所有的钱都装进一枚巨大的火箭，送上去吧，这样他们就能建一家 Arby’s，等我们被迫撤离地球时用。谢谢。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix34
: That is {i}not{/i} what Rocket Money is, Molly.
lines.zh: : Rocket Money 才{i}不是{/i}干这个的，Molly。

lines.en: : Ahh, but it {i}could{/i} be! Just like how you {i}could{/i} be the winner of tomorrow’s trivia contest against Io Ichimonji! How do you plead?!
lines.zh: : 哎呀，可它{i}可以{/i}是啊！就像你{i}也可能会{/i}赢下明天对 Io Ichimonji 的冷知识比赛一样！你认不认罪？！

lines.en: : Guilty. And so I hereby grant myself a life sentence to loving my future husband, Akira Arakawa. Congratulations to Io on her win and apologies to Ami for her loss.
lines.zh: : 认罪。因此我在此判处自己无期徒刑——去爱我未来的丈夫，Akira Arakawa。恭喜 Io 获胜，也向 Ami 致以落败的歉意。

lines.en: : And what do you have to add to that, Io?
lines.zh: : Io，你有什么要补充的吗？

lines.en: : Nothing. Don’t talk to me. This is stupid and I’m only doing it because Otoha dragged me here.
lines.zh: : 没有。别跟我说话。这很蠢，我来只是因为 Otoha 把我拽来的。

lines.en: : Just only minimally acknowledge her existence. I’ve found that’s really the best way to handle Io.
lines.zh: : 只要最低限度地承认她的存在就行了。我发现这真的是对付 Io 最好的办法。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix35
: And what an excellent- wait! Cool camera angle shift! I'm sure that was some sort of artistic choice and not just a mistake at all!
lines.zh: : 多么出色的——等等！酷炫的镜头切换！我敢肯定那是某种艺术处理，绝对不是失误！

lines.en: : But, as I was saying, what an excellent skill that deciphering such things might be! Because being family means being attentive to one another’s needs! And if Otoha can do that later today, Ami could be in trouble!
lines.zh: : 不过，正如我刚才说的，能读懂这些东西该是多么出色的一项技能啊！因为一家人就意味着要留意彼此的需求！如果 Otoha 今天晚些时候能做到，Ami 可就麻烦了！

lines.en: : It’s definitely going to be weird competing in some sort of “family” contest that doesn’t involve my dad. I still imagine I have the upper hand, though.
lines.zh: : 参加这种没有我爸参与的「亲情」比赛，肯定挺怪的。不过我还是觉得自己占上风。

lines.en: : I imagine you do as well. Because, from what I understand, one of the judges is going to be Chika’s sister. And Chika isn’t exactly my biggest fan, so...
lines.zh: : 我想你确实占上风。因为据我所知，评委之一是 Chika 的姐姐。而 Chika 算不上我的头号粉丝，所以……

lines.en: : I don’t think Chika’s really much of anything right now, to be honest. She’s too focused on when Niki’s going to show up.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得 Chika 现在什么状态都算不上。她满脑子只有 Niki 什么时候会出现。

lines.en: : Did you hear that, viewers? {i}The{/i} Niki Nakayama will be making an appearance at this year’s Dorm Wars! But how could she not when she’s already gone {i}public{/i} about her love for our very own teacher?!
lines.zh: : 观众朋友们听到了吗？{i}那位{/i} Niki Nakayama 会在今年的宿舍战争中登场！她都已经{i}公开{/i}表示对我们这位老师的爱意了，又怎么会不来呢？！

lines.en: : {size=-5}Which is why we’ve decided to call {i}this{/i} year’s Dorm Wars the “Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars: Round 6 ~ A Competition That Definitely Does Not Exist so Twenty High School Girls Can Have an Excuse to Pursue the Boyfriend of a Famous Idol That They All Love and Admire!”{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-5}所以我们决定把{i}今年{/i}的宿舍战争命名为「超级无敌究极宿舍战争：第六轮～一场绝对不存在的比赛，好让二十个高中女生有借口去追一个她们全都爱戴的知名偶像的男朋友」！{/size}

lines.en: : These titles are getting fucking ridiculous.
lines.zh: : 这些标题真是越来越他妈离谱了。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix36
: They sure are! But the entire {i}concept{/i} of twenty heroines duking it out for the love of a grown man is ridiculous! So we do what we can! Don’t we, girls?!
lines.zh: : 可不是嘛！可「二十位女主角为了一个成年男人的爱而大打出手」这整个{i}设定{/i}本身就很离谱！所以我们只能尽力而为！对吧，姑娘们？！

lines.en: : For anyone watching us inside or outside of the school right now, I, Ami Arakawa, would like to formally confirm that I {i}am{/i} romantically interested in my father.
lines.zh: : 致此刻在校内或校外收看我们的所有人：我，Ami Arakawa，正式确认我{i}确实{/i}对我父亲抱有恋爱意义上的兴趣。

lines.en: : And I am saying this to dispel all rumors about me and label this information as factual. Please send any and all fan-art or fan-fiction of us together to my email address: arakawaami@kumonmihigh.edu.
lines.zh: : 我之所以这么说，是为了澄清关于我的所有谣言，并把这条信息标注为事实。请把任何关于我俩的同人图或同人文发到我的邮箱：arakawaami@kumonmihigh.edu。

lines.en: : {i}Or{/i} you could ship him with the slightly more socially acceptable Ayane Amamiya — a girl who he only {i}kind{/i} of raised and isn’t related to by blood. Amamiyaayane@kumonmihigh.edu.
lines.zh: {i}或者{/i}，你也可以把他和稍微更能被社会接受的 Ayane Amamiya 凑成一对——那姑娘他只是{i}算{/i}养过，而且没有血缘关系。Amamiyaayane@kumonmihigh.edu。

lines.en: : Please don’t send me anything. I hate checking my email.
lines.zh: : 请不要给我发任何东西。我讨厌查收邮件。

lines.en: : And I hate this. Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 而我讨厌这个。再见。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix37
: We probably should have brought Uta along for Io’s segment, huh?
lines.zh: : 我们大概应该把 Uta 也叫来参加 Io 那一段的，对吧？

lines.en: : Oh man...competing against her tomorrow is going to be {i}weird.{/i} She definitely does not like me.
lines.zh: : 天哪……明天跟她比赛会很{i}诡异{/i}。她绝对不喜欢我。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. She likes a total of like three people and I imagine all of us but Otoha are at, like...the very bottom of that list.
lines.zh: : 是啊。她总共就喜欢那么三个人，我猜除了 Otoha 以外，我们全都在那份名单的……最底下。

lines.en: : Regardless of who likes who, we’re just thirty minutes from our official start time now! So we need to get the heck outta Falador and let our brand {i}new{/i} field reporter, Miku Maruyama, take over!
lines.zh: : 不管谁喜欢谁，距离正式开始只剩三十分钟了！所以我们得赶紧离开 Falador，让我们全{i}新{/i}的外景记者 Miku Maruyama 接手！

lines.en: scene dormwarssix38
: Thank you, Molly! And thank you to Rocket Money as well for building an Arby’s on the moon! My name’s Miku Maruyama and I’m here to expand my portfolio to include journalism as well!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Molly！也谢谢 Rocket Money 在月球上建了一家 Arby’s！我叫 Miku Maruyama，此行是为了把新闻工作也加进我的作品集！

lines.en: : {i}Why{/i} am I trying to expand my portfolio, you ask? I don’t know! But that doesn’t matter now because I’ve got a bunch of girls with me who are going to do some stuff to hopefully win a man-slave!
lines.zh: {i}为什么{/i}要扩充作品集，你问？我不知道！不过现在这不重要，因为我身边有一群姑娘，她们要做点事情，好赢下一个男人奴隶！

lines.en: scene dormwarssix39
: Maya! What would {i}you{/i} do with a man-slave?
lines.zh: : Maya！{i}你{/i}会拿一个男人奴隶干什么？

lines.en: : I don’t think I can say it on camera, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 这个我恐怕没法在镜头前说。

lines.en: : And how about you, Sana?
lines.zh: : 那你呢，Sana？

lines.en: : I’m ready and willing to say it on camera. I just probably shouldn’t at the risk of getting somebody in trouble.
lines.zh: : 我倒是准备好也愿意在镜头前说。只是大概不该说，怕害得谁惹上麻烦。

lines.en: : {size=-5}If I had a slave, I would chain him to the third-most marble pillar in the House of God and glue his feet to the stone floor so that he could never escape the light that slips in through the cracks in the ceiling and ultimately bleaches him with love and devotion to all things pure.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-5}如果我有个奴隶，我会把他锁在上帝之殿里第三根大理石柱上，把他的脚粘在石地板上，让他永远无法逃脱从天花板裂缝里漏进来的光，那光最终会用爱与虔诚、对一切纯净之物的爱，把他漂成白色。{/size}

lines.en: : And I’d probably just ask him to cook for me and hold my hand since I’m a good girl now.
lines.zh: : 而我大概只会让他给我做饭、牵我的手，因为我现在是个乖女孩了。

lines.en: : You ain’t foolin’ nobody, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 你骗不了任何人，Kirin。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix40
: But, thankfully, you won’t have to! Since your contest this year involves bein’ a barista and I’m pretty sure that’s another word for wrestling!
lines.zh: : 不过谢天谢地，你用不着！因为你们今年的项目是当咖啡师，而我敢肯定那就是摔跤的另一种说法！

lines.en: : Baristas make coffee. That’s what Rin and Molly are.
lines.zh: : 咖啡师是做咖啡的。Rin 和 Molly 就是干这个的。

lines.en: : That remains to be seen! And sounds like a pretty boring contest to me. I think we should make ‘em wrestle instead. Don’t you agree, viewers?!
lines.zh: : 那还有待观察！而且听起来这场比赛挺无聊的。我觉得我们应该让她们改成摔跤。观众朋友们，你们同意吧？！

lines.en: : I mean...it would definitely take the advantage Sana has away. Doesn’t she help out at her mom’s bar? How different can that be from making coffee?
lines.zh: : 我是说……那肯定会抹掉 Sana 的优势。她不是在妈妈的酒吧帮忙吗？那跟做咖啡能差多少？

lines.en: : Very when you take into account that there are nineteen different ways to brew coffee. At least that I’m aware of.
lines.zh: : 差很多——只要你考虑到煮咖啡有十九种不同的方法。至少我知道的有十九种。

lines.en: : Oh, good. So I just need to learn one of them. Fun.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。那我只需要学会其中一种就行。真有意思。

lines.en: : I’m also open to wrestling instead if...that’s what you’d prefer. Starting on equal footing is...probably the best for the sanctity of the competition.
lines.zh: : 如果……你们更想摔跤，我也没意见。站在同一起跑线上……大概对比赛的公正性最好。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix41

: A surprising outlook from the shortest girl in class! Has somethin’ changed about your outlook recently, Sana? Cause I kinda figured you’d wanna take any advantage possible if it meant winnin’ Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这话从全班最矮的姑娘嘴里说出来真让人意外！Sana，你最近心态变了？因为我本来以为只要能赢到 Sensei，你会不择手段地占尽优势。

lines.en: : I’m going to win him regardless of this competition’s outcome...so anything is fine, really...
lines.zh: : 不管这场比赛结果如何，我都会赢到他……所以怎样都行，真的……

lines.en: scene dormwarssix42
: Oh. So {i}you{/i} are my enemy as well now. Good to know.
lines.zh: : 哦。那{i}你{/i}现在也是我的敌人了。知道了。

lines.en: : Ya know, Maya, your {i}real{/i} enemy is Yasu. And from what I’ve heard, you actually ain’t half bad when it comes to strokin’ the pen.
lines.zh: : 我说，Maya，你{i}真正{/i}的敌人是 Yasu。而且我听说，你在「挥笔」这件事上其实挺有两下子的。

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. I thought there were more letters coming. Yes, I can draw. But this contest involves me being in the presence of a child, to which I refuse to even feign excitement.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。我以为后面还有别的字母要说。是的，我会画画。但这场比赛要我跟一个小孩待在一起，对这种事我连假装兴奋都懒得装。

lines.en: : That said, Yasu will likely win because I imagine I’ll be disqualified for violence.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，Yasu 大概会赢，因为我觉得自己会因为有暴力行为被取消资格。

lines.en: : I hate violence. And I love children! They are much easier to convince and convert.
lines.zh: : 我讨厌暴力。而且我爱小孩！他们更容易被说服、被感化。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix43

: Right! Well, I’ve clearly lost control of this group of contestants, so I’d like to take this opportunity to welcome our next batch of gals who will hopefully be a little more emotionally competent!
lines.zh: : 好！好吧，我显然已经管不住这一批选手了，那么我想借此机会欢迎我们的下一批姑娘，希望她们在情绪上稍微正常一点！

lines.en: scene dormwarssix44
: Yup! That’ll do it.
lines.zh: : 嗯！这就够了。

lines.en: : Girl.
lines.zh: : 女孩。

lines.en: : Girl, indeed! And I’m sure we both know which “girl” you’re talkin’ about, Chika. So tell me, as the alleged number one fan of Noriko’s sister, how excited are you to see her on a scale of one to ten?
lines.zh: : 确实是女孩！而且我肯定咱俩都知道你说的「女孩」是哪个，Chika。那么告诉我，作为所谓 Noriko 姐姐的头号粉丝，你有多期待见到她？一到十分打个分？

lines.en: scene dormwarssix45
: Girl.
lines.zh: : 女孩。

lines.en: : Is it just me or should we be, like...{i}actually{/i} worried about her right now?
lines.zh: : 是我一个人的感觉，还是说我们是不是该……{i}真的{/i}为她担心一下？

lines.en: : I think it’s...{i}probably{/i} fine? My sister does have this sort of effect on girls. And Chika’s already encountered her once, so I imagine there’s some lingering admiration still floating around.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……{i}大概{/i}没事吧？我姐姐确实对女孩子有这种效果。而且 Chika 已经见过她一次了，所以我想她心里应该还残留着一些仰慕。

lines.en: : Then, as the sister of this famous idol who I ain’t ever really listened to, what can {i}you{/i} tell us about how she’s going to “participate” this year, Noriko?
lines.zh: : 那么，作为这位我从没认真听过歌的知名偶像的妹妹，{i}你{/i}能告诉我们她今年要怎么「参与」吗，Noriko？

lines.en: : Nothing. I’m under NDA. And Nee-chan isn’t really talking to me lately based on “recent transgressions of mine.”
lines.zh: : 没什么可说的。我签了保密协议。而且基于「我近期的一些过失」，老姐最近也不太跟我说话。

lines.en: : So what I’m hearin’ is that you’re gonna destroy your opponent in the cooking competition?
lines.zh: : 那我听到的意思就是，你要在烹饪比赛里把对手打得落花流水？

lines.en: : Now, I don’t have the best hearing either, but I’m not really sure how that’s what you got out of literally anything I just said.
lines.zh: : 我的听力也不是很好，但我真搞不懂你从我刚才说的任何一句话里是怎么得出这个结论的。

lines.en: : I imagine Miku just picked up on the confidence I’m exuding knowing I am going to dominate Rin later!
lines.zh: : 我猜 Miku 是捕捉到了我散发出的自信——因为我知道待会儿我要把 Rin 按在地上！

lines.en: scene dormwarssix46
: Hot.
lines.zh: : 好辣。

lines.en: : No, like...uhh...
lines.zh: : 不是，我是说……呃……

lines.en: : Weird. I always thought of you as more of a bottom.
lines.zh: : 奇怪。我一直觉得你是当受的那个。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix47
: I am! N...Not like that matters, though! I just meant in the...contest! I get {i}paid{/i} to flirt with people and you’re historically bad at that!
lines.zh: : 我确实是！不……不过那不重要！我只是说在……比赛里！我是{i}收钱{/i}跟人调情的，而你这辈子调情就没行过！

lines.en: : I don’t know, Uta. You seem like the flustered one right now. Who’s to say that won’t happen during the competition?
lines.zh: : 不好说啊，Uta。现在看起来慌的人是你。谁说得准比赛的时候不会这样呢？

lines.en: scene dormwarssix48
: Th...That’s just because you haven’t factored in my secret weapon yet. I’m still in {i}regular{/i} Uta mode. And so long as I’m able to suppress that during the contest, Rin is as good as dead.
lines.zh: : 那……那只是因为你还没算上我的秘密武器。我现在还在{i}普通{/i} Uta 模式。只要在比赛期间把它压住，Rin 就必死无疑。

lines.en: : I’m just trying not to think about the competition, honestly.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我只是尽量不去想比赛的事。

lines.en: : I’ve learned through experience that no amount of preparation actually helps me when it comes to stuff like this and that I kinda just need to vibe in order to succeed in literally anything.
lines.zh: : 经验告诉我，在这种事情上不管怎么准备都没用，我大概只要随便来点感觉，就能在任何事上成功。

lines.en: : Girl.
lines.zh: : 女孩。

lines.en: scene dormwarssix49
: Yes, Chika. {i}Girl.{/i} Very good. Now try to say “Rin” next. Or “Chika.” Or literally anything else to show us that you’re still in there somewhere and not just a zombie now.
lines.zh: : 对，Chika。{i}女孩{/i}。很好。现在试着说「Rin」。或者「Chika」。或者随便说点别的，好让我们知道你还在里面，不是已经变成僵尸了。

lines.en: : Girl.
lines.zh: : 女孩。

lines.en: : You heard it here first, folks! And while some of ya might think it’s bad that we’re televisin’ some innocent girl’s descent into madness, that’s exactly the kinda thing ya need to expect from the Dorm Wars!
lines.zh: : 各位，您是从这儿最先听到的！虽然有些人可能觉得，把一个无辜女孩走向疯狂的过程播出去不太好，但这正是你们该对宿舍战争抱有的期待！

lines.en: scene dormwarssix50
: Before we let our sponsors take it away, though, there is one more thing we’ve gotta address!
lines.zh: : 不过在把时间交给赞助商之前，还有一件事我们得说！

lines.en: scene dormwarssix51
: And it’s that your beloved field reporters will be takin’ part in our own contests as well!
lines.zh: : 那就是——你们最爱的外景记者们，也会参加我们自己的比赛！

lines.en: : That’s right, people! So tomorrow, you can look forward to me learnin’ how to act by puttin’ on my own play thingy over at Sara’s place!
lines.zh: : 没错，各位！所以明天，大家可以期待我在 Sara 那儿搞一出自己的小剧，学习怎么演戏！

lines.en: : And you can look forward to {i}me{/i} failing miserably at some sort of obstacle course since I, too, am allergic to physical activity! Much like many of {i}you{/i} out there!
lines.zh: : 而大家可以期待{i}我{/i}在某种障碍赛道上惨败，因为我也一样对体育活动过敏！就像屏幕前{i}你们{/i}中的许多人一样！

lines.en: : So stay tuned and stay...I don’t know! Some other word that starts with T!
lines.zh: : 所以请锁定频道，继续……我不知道！随便哪个以 T 开头的词！

lines.en: : Terrible!
lines.zh: : 糟透了！

lines.en: : Yeah! You guys suck! Which is why you’re all still inside while we get to hang out here and have fun!
lines.zh: : 对！你们真烂！所以你们全都还得待在教室里，而我们却能在这儿开心地玩！

lines.en: : Tsuneyo also begins with the letter T.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo 也是 T 开头的。

lines.en: : Be quiet. I think they forgot about us.
lines.zh: : 安静。我觉得他们把我们忘了。

lines.en: : We’ll be back soon after a quick message from our sponsors!
lines.zh: : 一段赞助商快讯之后，我们马上回来！
